GuidesAndToursList.offerWalkthroughsWhenOpeningAView: Offer walkthroughs when opening a view for the first time

registry.mapAndVisionSideBySide: Map and vision side by side
registry.theSplitButtonOnTheMap: The Split button on the map shares the panel with Vision. Drag the divider to set the size; the Pilot layout starts this way with synthetic vision.
registry.theWorkspaceButtonSwitchesBetweenPilot: The Workspace button switches between Pilot, FPV and Mission, each with its own panels, cockpit instruments and split. Save your own and share them as a file.
registry.dragOneMapInstrumentOntoAnother: Drag one map instrument onto another to dock them into a shared card. Drag a member back out to free it, or scale the whole group at once.
